propositions: Create a new Pydantic output-policy adapter that exposes deterministic parse+validation through a TextOutputFunc without introducing a new retry loop.
The adapter must preserve the existing parse_structured and check_response authorities as the sole parser/guard entry points, maintaining byte-for-byte parser behavior.
Implement stop/refusal safety via an after_model_request capability hook that raises UnretryableOutputError (terminal) or StructuredOutputError (retryable) before the output function processes text.
Retryable validation failures must raise ModelRetry with the exact original Rebar StructuredOutputError preserved in the __cause__ chain, allowing Pydantic AI to drive bounded output retry.
The adapter must not add retry loop, provider selection, usage projection, or persistence logic; those concerns move to separate work.
Historical repair, sentinel, and decoy-selection behavior must produce identical values before and after adapter integration.
